body: serve() finds the project of the start directory (if any) as default and serves every registry entry: GET/POST /api/projects (counts: tickets, open, in progress, last update), DELETE /api/projects/:id (registry only), all project routes under /api/projects/:id/..., ticket routes accept KEY-n, unscoped /api/... map to the default project (404 outside a repository). Projects open lazily with the record cache; error messages strip every project root. CLI serve registers the start project and works from any directory.
author: claude
